capabilities: : Applies to tables, callouts, code blocks, and list items
: Works in Reading view and Live Preview
: Auto-switches to Reading view on search result click
disambiguation: It is specifically designed to refine the highlight behavior when opening a note from a search result, not for general in-note searching or vault-wide selection.
intentEvidence: This plugin makes the persistent highlight keyword-precise for those blocks.
problem: When opening a note from search results, Obsidian's default behavior highlights the entire block or cell instead of just the matched keyword within complex structures.

relations.evidence: Editor-only; not driven by search-result open
Skips rendered tables in Live Preview (needs Source mode)
It is an in-note find, not the search-result-open flow
Highlights the full row, not the keyword
Highlight lives in the result list, not the rendered note

summary: Keyword-precise highlighting for matched text within complex Markdown blocks (tables, callouts, code) when opening a note from search results.
